item.text: {"explanation":"Maintains a bounded FIFO array of residents. Each resident stores its key, value, pin count, and tombstone flag. Live puts replace values in place; new puts evict the oldest unpinned resident when necessary. Pinning, unpinning, invalidation, and reads follow the specified statuses and visibility rules. The output is reconstructed after every event.","program":"function solve(a){var c=a.config,s=a.state||{cap:c.capacity,r:[]},r=s.r,e=a.event,k=e.key,t=e.type,i=-1,j;for(j=0;j<r.length;j++)if(r[j][0]===k){i=j;break}var z='ignored',v=null;if(t==='put'){if(i>=0){if(r[i][3])z='blocked';else{r[i][1]=e.value;z='stored'}}else if(r.length<s.cap){r.push([k,e.value,0,false]);z='stored'}else{for(j=0;j<r.length&&r[j][2]>0;j++);if(j<r.length){r.splice(j,1);r.push([k,e.value,0,false]);z='stored'}else z='blocked'}}else if(t==='pin'){if(i>=0&&!r[i][3]){r[i][2]++;z='pinned'}}else if(t==='unpin'){if(i>=0&&r[i][2]>0){r[i][2]--;z='released';if(!r[i][2]&&r[i][3])r.splice(i,1)}}else if(t==='invalidate'){if(i<0)z='missing';else if(!r[i][2]){r.splice(i,1);z='invalidated'}else{r[i][3]=true;z='invalidated'}}else if(t==='get'){if(i>=0&&!r[i][3]){z='hit';v=r[i][1]}else z='miss'}var o={order:[],pins:{},status:z,tombstones:[],value:v};for(j=0;j<r.length;j++){o.order.push(r[j][0]);o.pins[r[j][0]]=r[j][2];if(r[j][3])o.tombstones.push(r[j][0])}o.tombstones.sort();return{state:{cap:s.cap,r:r},output:o}}"}
